Planning your visit

Location, listed hours and website visit requests.

Where is Fort Sam Houston Community Pharmacy?+

The Google Maps listing gives the address as 2401 Winfield Scott Rd, Fort Sam Houston, TX 78234, located in the Fort Sam Houston Exchange. Call (210) 295-9371 for questions about the location or collection arrangements.

What are the listed opening hours?+

Google Maps lists Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; Saturday, 9 a.m.–3 p.m.; Sunday, closed. Times are local Central Time. Federal holiday and special operating hours may differ, so confirm with the pharmacy before a special trip.

Can I request a visit on this website?+

Yes. Use the quick visit form with your name, contact number, a general reason and preferred date/time. A request starts as Pending and is confirmed only when staff accept it.

This does not activate a prescription, check benefit eligibility or guarantee a medication is ready. Use official pharmacy channels for prescriptions.

How do I see a confirmation or a denial reason?+

Open Visit history. Keep the private access code provided with your first request and use it with your phone number on another device. A phone number alone cannot unlock your requests.

The history shows the confirmed date/time or the reason a request was denied. SMS updates depend on the messaging service being enabled and delivery being available.

Can the pharmacy change my requested time?+

Staff can review the preferred time and confirm an available alternative. Check the date and time in Visit history before traveling. If it does not work for you, call the pharmacy to discuss the arrangements.

What if I need accessibility or installation access information?+

Call the pharmacy before traveling and describe the practical assistance you need. Confirm the entrance, collection arrangements and any installation access requirements through the appropriate official channels.

Prescriptions & pickup

Official routes for activation, refills and collection.

Does submitting a visit form activate a prescription?+

No. A website visit request is separate from prescription activation. Follow the current instructions in the official BAMC pharmacy information or contact the pharmacy.

How do I request a refill?+

Follow your prescription label or the official refill route, which may include the MHS GENESIS Patient Portal. For an expired prescription or one with no refills remaining, contact your prescriber about a renewal. This website does not submit refill requests.

Can Q-Anywhere be used for refills?+

TRICARE describes Q-Anywhere as a route for new prescription activation. Use the official refill channel for an existing prescription. Check the local pharmacy instructions for current availability and operating arrangements.

Can someone else collect for me?+

Ask the pharmacy what identification and authorization it currently requires for collection on your behalf. Requirements may depend on the prescription and circumstances. Make the arrangements directly rather than putting identification documents into a website form.

What if I need a prescription urgently?+

Contact the pharmacy or your prescribing healthcare team promptly. They can explain the appropriate next step for your prescription and situation. The website request inbox is not an urgent-care service. In an emergency, call 911.

Benefits, questions & feedback

Eligibility resources, practical questions and reviews.

Who can use a military pharmacy?+

Military pharmacy services depend on beneficiary eligibility and applicable pharmacy rules. Use the official TRICARE eligibility information and confirm your circumstances with the appropriate service. A website request does not establish eligibility.

What should I bring when asking about medication?+

Bring the packaging or a current list and a note of the questions you want clarified. Discuss symptoms and personal medical information directly with the pharmacist; do not put those details in the public review form.

Can I return unwanted medication?+

Call first to ask which local take-back arrangements are available and whether the item can be accepted. Needles and sharps need separate handling. The FDA disposal guidance explains the options.

Are the Google rating and website reviews the same?+

No. The Google rating is a dated snapshot of the linked Google Maps listing. Reviews submitted here are website reviews and are labeled separately. Submitting this form does not post anything to Google.

How do website reviews get published?+

Choose a rating, enter a display name and write about your experience. Reviews are checked for privacy and relevance before publication; feedback of all ratings is welcome. Avoid medication names, medical details, identification numbers or other people’s private information.
